entities.summary: Literacy is the ability to read for knowledge, write coherently, and think critically about the written word; it enables individuals to read, write, and use arithmetic. This fundamental skill has been a cornerstone of human progress, allowing people to access knowledge, express themselves, and participate in the global economy. The development of literacy has been a gradual process, with ancient civilizations such as the Sumerians, Egyptians, and Greeks making significant contributions to its evolution. The spread of literacy has been facilitated by various factors, including the rise of trade, the growth of cities, and the invention of the printing press. As a result, literacy has played a crucial role in shaping the course of human history, influencing the development of education, literature, and science. Today, literacy remains a vital skill, essential for individuals to navigate the complexities of modern life, participate in the workforce, and engage with the world around them.
